issues: Hypoglycemia exposure at 5.1% of readings below 70 mg/dL, exceeding the standard <4% threshold
Postprandial and afternoon hyperglycemia peaks reaching up to 293 mg/dL with time above range at 8.9%
Absence of declared meal carbohydrate entries resulting in reliance on reactive UAM/SMB automation
summary: Analysis of 14 days of Nightscout telemetry and AAPS profile data reveals an 86.0% Time in Range with significant glycemic variability (SD 39.7 mg/dL). While automated closed-loop delivery (SMB/UAM) successfully manages unannounced intake, it leads to postprandial excursions and periodic overlapping insulin action contributing to 5.1% time below range. Static profile parameters remain stable, but lack of meal carb declarations increases reliance on reactive automation.
education: Super Micro Boluses (SMB) and Unannounced Meal (UAM) detection allow closed-loop systems to manage glucose spikes without manual carb entries, but reactive dosing can lead to delayed action and subsequent stacking
Hypoglycemia risk below 70 mg/dL requires careful evaluation of overlapping insulin on board (IOB) from correction boluses and aggressive micro-bolusing
Dynamic sensitivity scaling adjusts effective ISF in real time based on glucose deviations, complementing static profile settings
strengths: High data quality and sensor coverage (98.7% over 14 days)
Strong overnight stability with average glucose maintained between 90 and 106 mg/dL in early fasting windows
Effective closed-loop automation keeping Time in Range at 86.0% overall
safety_notes: This is decision-support content only. The user must independently verify every proposed change, make changes one at a time, and monitor glucose closely.

recommendations.title: Introduce Manual Carbohydrate Logging
recommendations.description: Logging carbohydrate amounts and timestamps for meals will allow the closed-loop system to transition from reactive UAM/SMB detection to proactive insulin delivery, reducing postprandial peaks and subsequent IOB stacking.

suggested_change.rationale: Improves prediction accuracy and reduces reliance on reactive micro-boluses

profile_recommendation.rationale: Current basal segments, CR segments, ISF, targets, and DIA maintain a high Time in Range (86.0%) under closed-loop automation, and altering them without preliminary meal-logging data risks destabilizing control.
profile_recommendation.next_check: Log carbohydrates for at least 3 to 5 meals over the next 48 hours to evaluate how well current carb ratios match postprandial responses before considering profile adjustments.
profile_recommendation.recommendation: Keep all current profile settings unchanged and initiate structured meal logging.
